message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel chart showing the effect of experience on navigation performance: grouped benchmark results, training curves for five experience ratios, and validation bars by ratio.","description":"Panel (a) is a grouped bar chart with Performance (%) on a 0–60 vertical axis and AppWorld and BFCL on the horizontal axis. The four series are Avg@4: w/o exp. (light blue), Avg@4: w/ exp. (blue), Best@4: w/o exp. (light pink), and Best@4: w/ exp. (pink). AppWorld bars are 15.35, 20.32, 25.17, and 31.68, respectively; BFCL bars are 32.83, 38.60, 52.20, and 59.13. Dotted vertical comparison arrows between the paired average bars and paired best bars are labelled +4.97% and +6.51% for AppWorld, and +5.77% and +6.93% for BFCL.\n\nPanel (b) plots Avg@8 (%) against Training Steps (0–80, marked every 10; vertical scale 10–70). The legend shows a dashed gray Baseline (η=0.00) and four solid Navigating curves: η=0.25, η=0.50, η=0.75, and η=1.00. All curves rise overall from roughly 14–17 at step 0. The η=0.50 curve finishes highest, around 65; η=0.75 ends around 59, η=0.25 around 56, η=1.00 around 53, and the baseline around 51. The inset, titled “Validation performance w/ varying exp. ratios η,” contains five horizontal bars ordered by ratio 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, and 1.00, with printed values 16.23, 16.45, 19.30, 20.18, and 23.25, respectively.
